item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: FileOS 1.2.1
item.description:
Finder Alternative for macOS File Manager

FileOS is a native file manager for macOS 15 and later, built with SwiftUI. It can be used as an alternative to or in conjunction with Finder, integrating file organization, project resource aggregation, disk cleanup, and access to development tools into a single interface. It supports viewing up to four folders simultaneously in a single window, saving frequently used layouts, and using keyboard shortcuts to copy or move files between panels. The Workspace can centrally display files and folders from your local computer, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, and external hard drives without changing their original locations. The Download Organizer feature allows grouping by type or date added, as well as categorized filing after previewing. Smart Cleanup explains the reasons for cleaning up items such as caches, duplicate files, and installation packages, moving them to the Trash first and supporting undo. Search can match folder names, file names, and document content, directly displaying matching text. Combined with file previews, Markdown editing, bookmark collections, and the drag-and-drop shelf at the top of the screen, it reduces the steps required for daily operations. Developers can also view Git status, package sources, AI programming tool configurations and usage, and quickly open a terminal or editor.

item.title: BlurData 1.6.6
item.description:
macOS Document Desensitization Software

BlurData is a native document redaction tool for macOS that can natively process PDFs, scanned documents, and JPG and PNG screenshots, automatically identifying sensitive information such as names, email addresses, physical addresses, IP addresses, URLs, monetary amounts, account numbers, and license plates. The software offers two processing methods: permanent redaction and pseudonymization. The former removes selected text from the exported PDF or converts the redacted areas of the image into pixels; The latter replaces sensitive content with consistent tags across pages, preserving contextual relationships to facilitate the handover of processed documents to ChatGPT, Claude, or colleagues for analysis, while the mapping of actual information remains local. Built-in document presets include multilingual OCR, tax forms, bank statements, medical records, and invoices, and it also supports custom matching rules and batch processing of entire folders. Users can review the detection results item by item, close specified categories, double-click to add words, or select signatures, seals, and any page area by drawing a box, and detect QR codes and barcodes as needed.

item.title: Thumbwise 1.0.35
item.description:
Organize iPhone Home Screen on Mac

Thumbwise is a tool for organizing the iPhone Home Screen on a Mac. It reads the phone's layout via a USB cable, allowing you to adjust the positions of apps, folders, and widgets on your computer, and then apply the confirmed layout directly to your iPhone. It provides an App Bank temporary storage area, making it easy to temporarily remove apps when redesigning pages; Moving a single app does not disrupt the positions of other apps, and apps that were originally kept only in the App Library will remain there. Based on the available app usage data from the past 30 days, the software can estimate the number of swipes between Home Screen pages and optimize the layout through different organization modes to reduce the number of page turns when searching for frequently used apps. With the MCP tool, you can also connect to compatible AI assistants, which, after authorization, will arrange icons according to criteria such as color. The changes will be applied only after you review the results. The home screen layout and app activity data are stored locally, with no need to register an account or jailbreak the device.

item.title: AirBuddy 3.1
item.description:
macOS Bluetooth Headset AirPods Interaction Tool

AirBuddy 3 is an AirPods connection and peripheral management tool for macOS that integrates headphone connection, battery monitoring, media playback control, and cross-Mac peripheral switching into daily operations. The software uses a unified Action HUD interface to display nearby AirPods, connection progress, listening mode, currently playing content, and battery level alerts. It adapts its presentation based on the screen, allowing users to quickly view and control these features without interrupting their current tasks. Interactive widgets can be placed anywhere on the desktop, allowing for separate layouts on different monitors. They also enable viewing battery, headphone, and playback information on the lock screen. The redesigned dashboard centrally displays nearby and pinned devices, providing quick access to battery levels, controls, and settings. Magic Handoff allows you to transfer the Magic Mouse, Magic Keyboard, or Magic Trackpad between multiple Macs and clearly displays the connection progress. Users can also set low battery thresholds and notification styles for different devices to receive alerts when the battery is low or charging is complete. The software requires macOS 14 or later and is compatible with Macs with Intel and Apple chips.

item.title: Loop 1.0.9
item.description:
Mac Branded File Sharing Tool

Loop is a branded file sharing, read tracking, and online review and signing tool for macOS, suitable for entrepreneurs, sales teams, freelancers, and creative studios. Drag files into the sharing area to generate and automatically copy links. You can also share documents, images, audio and video files, and website files via the menu bar, Finder, and quick actions. The sharing page supports custom logos, color schemes, fonts, and domain names, and allows you to set passwords, email verification, expiration dates, watermarks, and download permissions. Recipients do not need to install software or register an account; they can view content, add annotations, provide feedback, and sign in their browser. Senders can track when the document was opened, the time spent reading each page, and video viewing statistics. They can also collect signatures in a predefined order and maintain a record of all signatures. Loop also offers features for converting screenshots and screen recordings into links, requesting file collections, and updating templates and versions. After updating a file, the original link can still be used. It also supports AI applications and Zapier automation. Files are stored in the user's own Cloudflare account, and account configuration must be completed before use. The software requires macOS 14 or later, and the screen recording feature requires macOS 15.

item.title: Fidelius 1.0.5
item.description:
macOS API Key Management

fidelius is a native development key management tool for macOS 15 and later. It stores API keys, access tokens, database connection addresses, and .p8 files in the macOS Keychain, reducing the instances of sensitive information being left in plain text in project .env files. The software organizes secrets by project, supports the use of different values for secrets with the same name in different projects, and can also share common configurations through the shared project, with project-specific values taking precedence. The accompanying command-line tool, accio, can pass secrets as environment variables to development, testing, or release commands, and provide temporary files for credentials that require files. It supports one-click configuration of Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, and makes every effort to mask unexpectedly output keys in specified proxy scenarios. However, it does not constitute a security isolation that prevents proxies from actively reading keys. Users can view and copy keys after authentication via Touch ID or Mac password, and manage configurations using tags, custom sorting, recently deleted items, and encrypted backups.

item.title: NotchDeck 2.1.0
item.description:
MacBook Notch Control Center

NotchDeck is a notch area control center for Apple Silicon MacBooks, centralizing system monitoring, media controls, app shortcuts, quick notes, and screen recording at the top of the screen. Hover over the notch or click the menu bar icon to open the panel. The software supports task configuration profiles, allowing you to copy and rename profiles and arrange the layout of applications and buttons separately, making it easy to organize frequently used operations according to different work scenarios. Screen recording can be set to full screen or a specific area, with the option to enable the microphone and system audio as needed. During recording, a timer and stop button are displayed. The interface offers eight themes, as well as light, dark, and automatic modes, paired with brightness and volume light effects, charging animations, configurable alerts, and low-battery pulses. Once the necessary permissions are granted, the neon effect can also be adjusted based on the background. The clipboard history must be enabled manually. It is only stored in memory and cleared upon exit. The software does not collect telemetry data or offer cloud synchronization. The interface supports English and Russian, with instant switching. It requires macOS 14 or later and does not support Intel Macs. External keyboard mapping is a developer preview feature and is not yet included in the release version linked on the page.

item.title: Verto 0.3.1
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Translation Tool

Verto is an offline translation tool that resides in the macOS menu bar. Once you select two languages, it automatically determines the translation direction, eliminating the need to repeatedly switch between the source and target languages. It is ideal for bilingual chats, reading foreign languages, and handling multilingual content. The software calls Apple's device-side Translation. framework, which supports 19 languages, including Chinese, English, Japanese, French, and German. After downloading the bidirectional language pack for the selected language pair for the first time, you can translate offline without an account or API key, and no telemetry data is collected. After entering or pasting text, translation will automatically start about 300 milliseconds after you stop typing. You can also use the global shortcut key to open the window, copy the translation, and close it, or manually switch the direction if the language is incorrectly identified. With built-in text recognition for selected screen areas, screen content can be extracted into an editable input box for easy review before translation. When the window is closed, the translation is saved in the history. The interface features a Liquid Glass style, offers English and Russian language options, and supports customizable hotkeys for activation.

item.title: CLO 3D 2025.0.84
item.description:
3D Garment Design Software for Mac

CLO 3D is a professional 3D garment design software for garment design and development. It combines realistic garment visuals with digital patterns that can be used for actual production, covering stages such as pattern making, design iteration, fit verification, production preparation, and visual presentation. Designers can use 3D digital samples to observe fabric drape, garment proportions, and color combinations, evaluate styles and fit during the development process, and provide intuitive guidance for collection planning and product decisions. The official platform provides over 2,000 assets, covering garments, fabrics, trims, and accessories, and offers pre-made patterns to help kick-start the design process. In conjunction with ecosystem products such as AI Studio, CLO-SET, and CONNECT, teams can further integrate creative ideation, collection reviews, production specification handoffs, and digital asset applications, allowing the same 3D garment asset to be used across more business scenarios. Completed digital garments can also be used for e-commerce displays, marketing content, and interactive experiences, extending the value of design outcomes. CLO3D is suitable for fashion designers, brand development teams, apparel companies, and faculty and students at related institutions. Official tutorials, user manuals, open workshops, and online learning platforms also support continuous learning.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.13.1
item.description:
Menu Bar Icon Hiding Tool

Hidden Bar is a tool for hiding macOS menu bar icons. How to use: Hold down the `⌘ Command` key in the menu bar, and two icons will appear, "｜" and ">". Then, drag the icon you want to collapse to the left of the "｜" icon. Click the ">" arrow icon to expand/collapse the menu bar icons. However, pay attention to a logical issue: the ">" icon cannot be placed to the left of the "｜" icon, as it cannot fold itself in.

item.title: TablePro 0.87.0
item.description:
Open source native macOS database tools

TablePro is a completely free and open source native macOS database client artifact, built for Mac users, using SwiftUI to build extremely fast startup, only about 50MB of memory, supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Redshift, SQL Server, Oracle, a total of nine mainstream databases, directly connected through their native C library or protocol without any Java/JDBC intermediate layer, providing Tree-sitter incremental syntax highlighting, multi-label editing Editor, intelligent schema-aware auto-completion, in-line Excel-style data editing (supports undo/redo, change tracking, multi-column sorting, filtering, paging, foreign key lookup, enum/set dropdown), CSV/JSON/SQL/XLSX import/export, SSH tunneling (with key/password authentication and ~/... ssh/config import), SSL/TLS encryption, macOS keychain secure storage credentials, automatic reconnection, connection color label management, and integration with powerful AI assistants (Claude, …

item.title: Bing Wallpaper 2.0.29.0
item.description:
macOS free wallpaper app

The Bing Wallpaper app lets you explore the world through a single image every day. Downloading this app will bring your desktop to life every day with beautiful images from around the world that have been featured on the background of Bing's homepage. This not only allows you to see different landscapes in front of your computer every day, but also allows you to browse through these pictures and learn where they come from, allowing you to gain insight and experience different cultures and nature while using your computer on a daily basis. Bring new life to your desktop every day by downloading Bing Wallpaper. Bing Wallpaper offers a selection of beautiful images from around the world that were featured on Bing's homepage. Not only will you see a new image on your desktop every day, but you'll also be able to browse through the images and learn where they came from. Discover a new place every day to bring your desktop to life.

item.title: OmniRoute 3.8.54
item.description:
Open-source Local AI Routing Platform

OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway and intelligent routing tool that can be run on macOS via npm, Docker, desktop applications, or source code. It unifies OpenAI-compatible interfaces, Claude, Gemini, Responses API, and a wide range of model services into a single local endpoint. It brings together 236 providers and supports automatic failover, subscription quota consumption, free quota statistics, cost-optimized routing, and multi-layer resilient protection, making it suitable for unified access to coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. The software features a built-in dashboard, 17 routing strategies, RTK and Caveman overlay compression, FTS5 and vector hybrid memory, MCP Server, A2A protocol, proxy and TLS fingerprint obfuscation, Guardrails, evaluation and analysis capabilities, allowing developers to manage keys, quotas, health status and request costs under a local-first architecture, reducing workflow friction caused by frequent configuration changes, quota interruptions and tool fragmentation.

item.title: Surge Relay 261118.1
item.description:
Surge Module Conversion Management Tool

Surge Relay is a centralized management tool for Surge modules on macOS. Based on Script-Hub's local conversion capabilities, it helps users to uniformly maintain module sources, alternative addresses, conversion rules, and release results. It is suitable for users who need to manage a large number of modules over the long term, or who frequently convert proxy tool formats such as Loon and Quantumult X to Surge .sgmodule files. The app can locally pull upstream content on Mac, perform conversions, apply custom rules, and publish the generated modules to a private GitHub repository and a stable address provided by Cloudflare. It also supports saving to iCloud Drive. iPhones, iPads, Apple TVs, and Macs only need to subscribe to a fixed URL, and subsequent upstream address changes, rule adjustments, MITM hostname blocking, and script disabling can all be done in one place. The graphical editing interface makes it easy to check module content and parameters, while remote management via the web interface supports viewing status, checking synchronization results, troubleshooting conversion issues, and modifying configurations.

item.title: Pika 2.0.3
item.description:
Menu Bar Screen Color Picker

Pika is an open-source macOS color picker application that helps users easily select colors from any screen and convert them to common color formats such as RGB, HEX, and CSS. Manually enter the RGB, HEX, CSS, and other formats of the color to select the color precisely.

item.title: OpenLess 2.0.2-tauri
item.description:
Open-source intelligent voice input tool

OpenLess is an open-source intelligent voice input tool for macOS users that uses global hotkeys to perform recording, speech recognition, text refinement, and insertion at the cursor position. Users simply place the cursor in any text box, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Notion, email, or chat windows, hold down the shortcut key while speaking, and release it to obtain the transcribed text. The app supports verbatim streaming input and automatically switches to the clipboard when encountering incompatible software to prevent content loss. It offers four output modes – raw transcription, light refinement, structured prompts, and formal expression – to transform natural speech containing pauses, colloquialisms, and minor inconsistencies into clearly structured AI prompts, emails, technical instructions, commit messages, or long-form messages. Users can create custom style packages, use keyboard shortcuts to switch writing styles, and install approved style schemes from the community marketplace. The built-in dictionary can use names, product names, and specialized terms as hotword identifiers and refinement prompts, and can also remember manually corrected words after user confirmation.

item.title: Tart Virtualization 2.42.0
item.description:
OpenAI Open-Source Automated Virtual Machine

Tart Virtualization is a virtualization toolkit for Apple Silicon Macs that can be used to build, run, and manage macOS and Linux virtual machines. It is suitable for continuous integration, software testing, and other automated tasks. It utilizes Apple's native Virtualization.Framework to deliver near-native performance on Apple Silicon devices, enabling developers to organize different system environments and build processes through virtual machines. Tart supports pulling virtual machines from container image repositories that are compatible with the OCI standard, and it can also push virtual machines to such repositories, making it convenient for teams to centrally store, distribute, and reuse environments. Together with the Tart Packer Plugin, you can automate the creation of virtual machines and reduce repetitive tasks during environment preparation. The software can be integrated into various CI systems and perform operations such as cloning and starting virtual machines via the command line, making it easy to incorporate into scripts and automated pipelines.

item.title: ClashMac 27.1.9
item.description:
A native, visually appealing Clash proxy tool for Mac

ClashMac is a native proxy tool designed specifically for macOS, built with the native SwiftUI framework and offering dual-mode proxy support. The software integrates traffic analysis, a topology view, and a route map to help users view the trajectory of their network connections in real time. Access all features with one click from the menu bar, including real-time upload and download speed graphs, subscription status monitoring, proxy group switching, and quick actions. Gain full control without opening the main window. The Route Map feature visualizes each active connection with flight paths, supports multi-hop routing, real-time flight updates, and color-coded continental routes. It also offers a Privacy Mode to randomize the departure city. The topology view clearly shows the complete path from the source IP to the process, rule, proxy, and finally to the exit, and supports multi-level nested groups. The system proxy and TUN enhanced mode can be enabled independently or simultaneously. Configuration management supports local YAML files and remote subscription imports, automatic updates, and intelligent parameter injection. The Control Center provides real-time traffic statistics, proxy group management, and connection logs. Features such as global hotkeys, video acceleration, and hot reloading further enhance the user experience, delivering a smooth and secure macOS network management solution.

item.title: LockIME 1.7.2
item.description:
macOS Input Method Lock Tool

LockIME is a native macOS menu bar input method locking tool that locks the keyboard input source to a specified state and immediately switches it back after the input method is changed by the user or another application. It supports global locking, as well as setting rules for each foreground application. When Enhanced Mode is enabled, it can match based on the browser URL, domain name, keywords, or a regular expression for the full URL. Each rule can be set to remain locked or to switch only once when entering an app or webpage, balancing stable control with the freedom of manual switching. The software provides a conflict identification mechanism. When it encounters programs, such as games, that continuously compete for the input method, it will temporarily yield and record the event in the log. It also supports process rules without application packages, global hotkeys, menu bar controls, login startup, 24-hour activation records, configuration backup import, automatic updates, and automation of the lockime URL protocol. The core locking feature does not require system permissions. Enhanced features such as website and focus fields require accessibility permissions. It supports instant switching between light and dark appearances and nine languages, and is compatible with macOS 14, as well as Apple silicon and Intel-based Macs.

item.title: Bob Pro 专业版 1.22.0
item.description:
powerful crossword AI translation tool for macOS

Bob is a convenient translation and OCR tool software with a variety of features to meet the needs of users. Its translation functions include crossword translation, screenshot translation, input translation, and translation using the PopClip plug-in. It also supports multi-open translation and word search functions, allowing users to save translation history and collect translation results against multiple translation services. In terms of OCR function, Bob can quickly identify text through screenshots, support silent screenshot OCR and access selection recognition. Offline recognition function is available for macOS 11 and above systems. Bob also has QR code recognition and intelligent segmentation function, and automatically copies the recognition results to the clipboard. Bob is a handy translation and OCR tool that integrates a variety of useful features to help users easily translate text and recognize image characters. Script Translation: Select the text you want to translate and press the Script Translation Shortcut (default + D) to translate quickly. Screenshot Translation: Press the Screenshot Translation shortcut (default aves + S) to intercept the area that needs to be translated.

item.title: Unread 5.2
item.description:
Reeder Alternative/RSS Feed Tool

Unread, an RSS reader designed to help users rediscover the joy of reading, offers beautiful typography, good handling of feed-only feeds, and a variety of color themes for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Unread highlighted the free sync between devices via the Unread Cloud service, which also supports syncing with services like Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, Inoreader, and NewsBlur. For feeds that only include a post feed, Unread automatically displays the full text on the webpage, and users can freely switch between the feed text and the webpage text, or even set the default webpage text display for a single feed. Unread offers "Subscribe in Unread" and "Save to Unread" sharing extensions that make it easy for users to subscribe to websites or save posts while browsing the web (subscription required). Unread also offers a variety of color themes, widgets to display the number of latest or unread articles, comprehensive VoiceOver support, web text and image caching for instant loading and offline access (subscription required), and native support for a variety of later-reading services.

item.title: StreamVox 1.6.5
item.description:
macOS Real-Time AI Speech Translation

StreamVox is an AI real-time speech translation and subtitling tool for macOS that captures system sounds, microphone inputs, or audio from specific apps to generate real-time, low-latency subtitles for online meetings, video sessions, live streams, games, video content, and face-to-face conversations. It supports 52 input languages and 60 translation languages, and provides six modes: universal, game, conference, live video, high-precision, and medical. It can optimize the recognition effect of terminology, tone, person name, number, drug name, and unit of measurement according to the scene. The two-way dialogue mode automatically determines the speaker and language, displaying the content of both sides in different colors, suitable for cross-language meetings, interviews, reception and customer support. Sticky subtitle windows always stick to the top and lock the position, support paragraph or line-by-line reading, and can also call macOS system voice to read the translation naturally. By app capture, you can only listen to specified programs such as Zoom, Teams, Safari, FaceTime, etc. to reduce other sound interference.

item.title: LicenseManagerPro 5.5.1
item.description:
macOS Software Key License Management Assistant

LicenseManagerPro is a software license management tool for Mac and iPad that helps users organize scattered keys, purchase dates, expiration dates, update support status, and related files in one place. It supports up to 4 keys per license, is suitable for family, team and multi-device authorization scenarios, can also add custom fields for vendors, invoice numbers, internal references, activation links, etc., and supports text, numbers, dates, URLs and attachment types. The app has built-in smart expiration reminders and update period notifications, so you can set an early reminder time as needed to avoid missing out on renewals; With private iCloud real-time sync, Mac and iPad data are always the same, independent of third-party servers. Users can also quickly manage large software collections with color classification, bulk editing, full-text search, recent viewing, attachment archiving, automatic icon import, and enhance privacy protection with Touch ID and automatic locking.

item.title: Dockside 2.9.38
item.description:
Efficient file management next to the Dock

Dockside is a file management app for Mac users designed to make the most of the free space near the Dock for quick access to frequently used files, folders, links, and applications. The app allows users to easily manage files through drag-and-drop operations and provides quick access to recent screenshots and downloads. Dockside is developed natively in Swift to ensure fast responsiveness and is Apple-certified to meet high security standards. Dockside offers a wide range of customization options and supports various practical features, such as creating quick notes, file compression, and image optimization, with the aim of improving work efficiency and user experience. Dockside is a user-friendly file shelf app designed for Mac, aimed at efficiently utilizing the free space around the Dock to provide users with quick access to frequently used files, folders, links, apps, and text snippets. Users can drag and drop these items into Dockside for immediate use or later access, while also enjoying quick access to recent screenshots and downloaded files, or monitoring their favorite folders.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.7-beta.1
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: Atlas 1.8.3
item.description:
Categorized Management of macOS Design Project Assets

Atlas is a private visual library for macOS, designed for designers, creators, and visual professionals to collect, organize, and browse inspirational images, videos, screenshots, and project files. It emphasizes localization and privacy, with all assets stored on your Mac. No account, cloud syncing, or social media feeds are required, making it ideal for those who want to centrally manage reference images, mood boards, design snippets, and project assets. The software offers two browsing modes: an infinite canvas and a grid. You can freely pan and zoom like on a whiteboard to view the overall structure of the visual board, or switch to a neat grid to quickly filter assets. Users can create separate libraries for different projects and quickly switch between multiple libraries to avoid mixing assets from different clients, products, or creative directions. Atlas also supports opening existing Eagle . The library facilitates the migration of existing asset materials or direct browsing. It is centered around the native macOS experience, striving for a lightweight, fast, and responsive interface. Atlas is a private visual library designed for macOS, ideal for designers, creators, photographers, and visual researchers to centrally store inspirational materials.

item.title: DiskFox 1.4.3
item.description:
Disk space analysis for macOS

DiskFox is a disk space analyzer and storage change tracker for macOS. It builds a scan baseline and compares scans over time to show what is using space, when it grew and why. It recognizes more than 60 kinds of storage that tend to pile up, including Apple Intelligence models, Xcode data, simulator runtimes, device backups, Docker disk images, app caches and Time Machine local snapshots, and it separates measured results from guessed causes. You can review large files, app usage and exact duplicates, see the impact and expected space recovered, then confirm; most selected files go to the Trash and nothing is cleaned automatically. Scans read only file sizes, dates and locations, duplicate checks run locally, nothing is uploaded, and no account is needed.

item.title: Floodtide 1.6.1
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.16.0
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: HoudahSpot 6.9.1
item.description:
Powerful file search tool for macOS

HoudahSpot is an advanced file search tool designed for macOS. As a powerful alternative to Spotlight, it helps users quickly locate documents, emails, photos, source code, and other files through an intuitive interface. It supports starting with simple keywords and gradually adding multiple criteria (such as file name, text content, file extension, author, image resolution, date, tags, etc.), and can search multiple folders simultaneously while excluding specific subfolders. Folders, Boolean logic combination queries, tag cloud filtering, top-level file display, attribute matching (e.g., images with GPS coordinates). The results list can be customized with hundreds of column views, grouped by type/date/size/application, with preview text highlighting matching context, and quick viewing of file information and metadata. Users can also save frequently used search templates (e.g., recent files, music library, application list) to speed up repetitive tasks. Compatible with macOS 10. 14 Mojave and later (including macOS 26 Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon architectures, offering advanced features such as regular expression filtering, AppleScript automation, and integration with other tools (e.g., Alfred, LaunchBar)…

item.title: Rectangle Pro 3.102
item.description:
Window Arrangement Layout Assistant

Rectangle Pro is an advanced window management tool designed specifically for macOS users, offering superior window management capabilities. Users can adjust windows to 16 different sizes and positions using simple keyboard shortcuts. It's easy to use and doesn't require memorizing complex shortcuts.
